name: rsi-post-training-skills
prior_digest_algorithm: Sort prior_files by UTF-8 path; for each file compute SHA-256 over path UTF-8 bytes, a NUL byte, file bytes, and a NUL byte; compute SHA-256 over the concatenated raw 32-byte per-file digests.
release_digest_algorithm: Canonicalize the full manifest as UTF-8 JSON with keys sorted and compact separators after removing only release_digest; compute SHA-256 over those bytes. Bootstrap binds both release_digest and prior_digest.
human_prior_boundary: manifest.json and every prior_files entry are read-only within a run. Calibrated notes remain separate context sources governed by calibrated_notes_policy.
calibrated_notes_policy: Bundled notes are not initial Human Prior. A legacy-unbound note may be read only inside a dedicated provenance-audit task and cannot justify action. It becomes Agent-loadable as context only when the human-approved project profile binds its exact digest and supplies version, provenance, evidence, and applicability scope in a Stage Context Packet.
runtime_policy: All mutable run state lives outside the installed Skill bundle, including bootstrap contexts/events, project profiles and capability locks, Stage Context Packets and cutoffs, Task Queue and attempts, experiments, decisions, artifacts, known defects, controller state, and learned memory.
